title: Blind surprise candidates and lab listening cycle
description: Create three contrasting score candidates from the newly added, unrated Commons catalog. Render and publish them as a blind listening cycle attached to a new Lab so the listener can select one to continue. No production score publication is implied by this preview cycle.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Selected three un-rated Commons recordings, generated fresh local analysis manifests only for Bitpop, ElectrowaveZ-Ayahuasca and Chiptune2, and rendered three contrasting 16-bar candidates. Measurements: metallic 98 (minor chord-coverage guard), liquid 100 (source layer intentionally quiet), robot 89 (uneven-beat and +9c tuning guards). Created Lab lab_403470bc015eefd2 anchored to the hidden metallic incumbent. Cloud `cycle publish` failed twice, deterministically uploading A/B then returning `service error` for `cycles/.../C.m4a`; no ListeningCycle was written, so no cycle attached. Local M4A previews remain ready for listener choice.
